articles.title: From Jade vine to Olive tree: 6 plants believed to bring good luck, harmony and positive energy
articles.description: Many cultures believe certain plants help create a calmer, more positive home environment, even though there is no scientific evidence that they remove negative energy. Some of the most popular choices include the exotic jade vine from the Philippines, the peace lily, lucky bamboo, the Mediterranean olive tree, the snake plant from West Africa, and holy basil or tulsi from India. Beyond their symbolism, these plants can brighten interiors, reduce stress, and make living spaces feel more peaceful and welcoming.
